name: plan-coverage-delta-decisions
body:
Provenance and decisions for the coverage-spec-delta change-set.

SOURCE. `apg plan verify`'s derived-coverage stage is scoped by spine reachability from satisfied requirements PLUS solution nodes added on the branch. In a repository with a pre-existing durable spec it forces fake `modifies` tasks over untouched code and blocks the merge gate. An earlier fix exempting unreachable pre-existing nodes is partial.

RECONCILIATION SEARCH. No existing authorable node describes this semantics. A graph query over `apg/layers` nodes by FQN and by body for `coverage`, `coverage-spine-scoped`, `derived solution`, `implemented-by edge`, and `coherence gate` returns no requirement/constraint/component/note stating the coverage rule; the `SPEC §5 coverage-spine-scoped` token appears only in `src/plan_cmd/verify.rs` doc-comments and is not an authored node (nor is there a matching `md.SPEC.md` coverage heading). The closest existing nodes are the plan-tooling SUITE-tool nodes (`domain.group.plan-tooling`, `domain.entity.plan-phases-tool`, `domain.value.project-requirement-scope`, `requirements.requirement.plan-phases-project-scoping`), which scope the `apg_plan_phases` suite tool to the project/branch — a different surface (the binary's gate vs the suite tool), left unchanged by this change-set. So this requirement is authored fresh, not a duplicate.

DECISIONS (the change-set brief supplies the law):
- BASE = merge-base of the branch with the default branch, not the default-branch tip, so main moving ahead does not pull other projects' changes into this branch's delta [from brief].
- REMOVED `implemented-by` edges / removed solution nodes: the removed code FQN must still be touched by a task (`deletes`/`modifies`) — the brief's proposed reading; flagged for confirmation [judgment].
- `Satisfies` no longer widens coverage; it remains the phase→requirement bridge for `apg_plan_phases` phase-health reporting and the human gate [judgment].
- A fresh repo with no pre-existing spec degenerates to the whole branch spec as delta [from brief].
- An in-scope solution node with no `implemented-by` edge stays a warning (`no_claims`), not a blocker [from brief].
- Verb-agnostic touching, renames/moves destination counting, and language-root-agnostic code identity carry over from the existing behaviour and are preserved [from brief].

The earlier partial exemption of unreachable pre-existing solution nodes is superseded: under the delta rule, unchanged pre-existing nodes are exempt unconditionally.
